title: Maximum local cardiac sampling load did not clearly improve cross-cohort PPG respiratory-error prediction
abstract: Maximum local cardiac sampling load did not clearly improve cross-cohort prediction of PPG respiratory-rate errors exceeding 3 breaths/min. BIDMC-trained models tested on independent CapnoBase had baseline/augmented Brier scores 0.136418/0.137620, gain -0.001202 [-0.003363, 0.001174]; reverse transfer gave 0.194200/0.193144, gain 0.001055 [-0.001541, 0.003389]. Both 95% paired target-record bootstrap intervals included zero. Pulse-rate-adjusted comparisons had near-zero gains. This exploratory negative result concerns a fixed feature and model, not absence of all cardiac-sampling information.
